aliasPolicy: Property-view accessors and explicit get_/set_ declarations sharing the same declaring class and file offset are one native body. All producer representations are retained.
terminalCallPolicy: A BL occupying the final instruction of a metadata-bound method implies a non-returning target; this is an inference used to stop exception paths from flowing into the next method. Call sites remain recorded.
